about.title: About Our Temple

Our temple has been serving the community for years, providing a place for worship, cultural events, and spiritual growth.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about booking and participating in sevas
faq.contactMessage: Our temple office is here to help you with any queries

items.question: Can I cancel or reschedule my seva booking?
items.answer: Yes, you can reschedule your seva up to 24 hours before the scheduled time by contacting the temple office. Cancellations are accepted with a minimum 48-hour notice. Please call us at +91 (555) 123-4567 for assistance.

items.question: What is the dress code for attending sevas?
items.answer: Traditional Indian attire is recommended. Men should wear dhoti-kurta or shirt-pants with angavastram. Women should wear saree, salwar kameez, or churidar. Please avoid shorts, sleeveless tops, and leather items inside the temple.

items.question: Will I receive prasadam after the seva?
items.answer: Yes, blessed prasadam is distributed to all participants after the completion of every seva. The type of prasadam varies based on the seva - it could be modaks, panchamrit, fruits, or specially prepared temple offerings.

items.question: Can family members participate in the seva?
items.answer: Absolutely! Family participation is encouraged and considered highly auspicious. Please inform us about the number of family members during booking so we can make proper arrangements. Children are welcome under adult supervision.

items.question: Is advance booking mandatory?
items.answer: For special sevas like Sahasranama Archana, Homam, and festival celebrations, advance booking is mandatory. For daily sevas like regular Archana and Abhishekam, walk-in participation is allowed subject to availability.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept cash, UPI payments, bank transfers, and online donations through our website. You can also sponsor sevas through check or demand draft payable to "Shri Vighneshwara Swamy Temple Trust".

items.question: Are there any special sevas for specific occasions?
items.answer: Yes, we offer customized sevas for birthdays, anniversaries, house warming (Grihapravesh), business inauguration, and other special occasions. Please contact our office to discuss your requirements and we'll arrange appropriate rituals.

items.question: Can I participate in the actual ritual or just observe?
items.answer: Participation level varies by seva type. For Archana and some pujas, you can actively participate under priest guidance. For technical rituals like Homam, observation is recommended unless you have prior experience. Our priests will guide you appropriately.

notice.title: Temple Notice
notice.content1: All sevas are conducted by experienced temple priests following traditional Vedic rituals and mantras. We maintain the highest standards of sanctity and devotion in all our services.

notice.content3: For special occasions, festivals, or large group bookings, please contact the temple office at least one week in advance for proper arrangements.

hero.title: A Sanctuary of Peace
hero.subtitle: Dedicated to Lord Vighneshwara, guiding devotees towards spiritual enlightenment in the heart of Bangalore since 1985.

deity.title: Remover of Obstacles
deity.description: Lord Ganesha, also known as Vighneshwara, is revered as the patron of arts and sciences and the deva of intellect and wisdom. As the god of beginnings, he is honoured at the start of rituals and ceremonies. In our temple, the Moolavar (main deity) is depicted in a seated posture, radiating calmness and benevolence to all who seek his blessings.

1985.description: Established by a group of devoted residents in a small temporary structure. The first idol was installed with simple rites, marking the beginning of a spiritual hub.

1995.description: First major consecration ceremony attended by thousands. The main Gopuram was constructed, and the sanctum sanctorum was formalized according to Agama Shastras.

2010.description: New hall dedicated to daily food distribution service. This allowed the temple to serve over 500 devotees daily with wholesome prasadam.

2023.description: Recent structural upgrades to the main sanctum, including the gold plating of the Vimana, enhancing the divine vibration of the temple premises.
